title: Leave Policy
content: Employees are entitled to 20 days of Earned Leave per year. Sick leave is capped at 12 days.

title: WFH Policy
content: Hybrid model: 3 days from office, 2 days from home.

title: Reimbursement Policy
content: Expenses up to $500 can be approved by managers. Higher amounts require Finance VP approval.

title: POSH Policy
content: Zero tolerance for harassment. Reach out to the IC committee for any concerns.
